read: Matt Damon as Odysseus in plumed Greek helmet and cloak leading troops through a forest backdrop — this wants the canonical image of the mythic warrior-king/hero of Troy, not just a generic soldier.
caption: Matt Damon channels the original brooding plume — Corinth just beat him to the etching press by a century.

options.label: A
options.title: Odysseus
options.why: Corinth's etching is literally titled 'Odysseus' and shows a plumed helm leading armed men in murky, chaotic terrain.

options.label: B
options.title: Ajax and Odysseus - Lochmann Hall, Landesmuseum Zurich
options.why: A mural explicitly depicting Ajax and Odysseus with troops massed behind them nails the Trojan-hero-and-army iconography.

options.label: C
options.title: Hermes Ordering Calypso to Release Odysseus
options.why: Lairesse's canonical Odysseus narrative gives the armored, cloaked hero figure even though the scene shifts to Calypso's isle.

options.label: D
options.title: Bronze mirror
options.why: An ancient Greek bronze mirror engraved with warrior figures nods to the ur-source imagery of Homeric heroes, in a purely graphic, antique register.

options.label: E
options.title: Odysseus receiving a bag of winds from Aeolus
options.why: Gandolfi's swirling sketch of Odysseus receiving the winds keeps the mythic voyage theme alive, if visually loose.
